summary.intent: Determine which of several pending work items could be run in parallel without file conflicts, and launch agent workers for them in a token/cost-conscious way without human ceremony.
summary.outcome: Launched two new parallel workers (convert-memo single-flight, early-session reuse) alongside an already-running declared.symbol worker, reaching the cap of 3. Other items were deferred due to file overlap or machine-load concerns. No worker results have been reviewed yet; only crates/semantic/src/convert.rs is listed as modified.

repo: Work is partitioned by file ownership: convert.rs and asked.rs (convert memo), early-session code in lib.rs/checker.rs/kept.rs (session reuse), and declared.rs (declared.symbol single-flight) do not overlap.
Readonly-from-property-flags and typed-request-structs both rewrite rpc.rs, so they collide with #512 and with each other and must be serialized after #512 merges.

Quality gates for changes: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, the semantic nextest, and `just test-checker-lane` must exit 0; the early-session worker also runs gate_harness determinism and memory checks.
Each change requires tests that fail on main, mutation proofs, and JSON-parsed output identical to a main build on at least two corpora, with degraded runs dropped.
Thread/program re-measure and RDT comparison need a quiet machine, so they cannot run while multiple builds are active.
Convert-memo single-flight design must avoid deadlock, which is why a stronger model (Opus) was assigned.
workflow: Cap concurrent workers at 3 and partition by file ownership to avoid collisions.
Give each worker a tool-call cap and require a 'not done, because' report if no sound result is reachable.
Assign stronger models only to subtasks with hard correctness risk (deadlock reasoning) to control cost.
Lead agent reviews each diff and re-runs gates and output diffs itself rather than trusting worker reports.

friction: Worker cap of 3 forced the small, independent harness-rejects-degraded-runs task (trail 471) to wait.
Concurrent builds make the machine too loaded for benchmark-style measurements.
open_items: Run readonly-from-property-flags and typed-request-structs sequentially after #512 merges.
Run thread/program re-measure and RDT comparison last on a quiet machine, or report CPU and counts if load stays high.
Start the harness-rejecting-degraded-runs task (trail 471) when a worker slot frees up.
Review each worker's diff, re-run gates and output diffs, including deadlock reasoning for the convert-memo change.
Report final numbers and a 'not verified' list as each worker finishes.
